MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

2. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

4. Solve for x: x + 3 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 8
   C. 3
   D. 7

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 1

6. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 24

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

9. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 37
   C. 36
   D. 13

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x < 5
   D. x > 5

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

13. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 1
   D. 21

14. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 17

15. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 64
   C. 65
   D. 16

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 5² = 5 × 5
3. 5² = 25
Final Answer: 25
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. C — 10

3. A — 144

Final Answer: 144 m²

Working:
